condition.depth: recorded float32 rounded to 1 mm, no added noise (D8b ③ contract)
condition.note: sample maxima of one synthetic camera model, not proven bounds; not for the real D435i

observation.distance: camera optical centre to the front face along the pallet axis

odometry.windows: every pair of control ticks inside each run's [first approach tick, insertion end], and the near capture's anchor sample (capture_control) against every later tick at the tracker's lookup age (tick time - the capture's aligned time); with the correction-run supplement's episodes the same way (e and psi only)
odometry.lookup: first grid age at or above the query; beyond the last age unbounded

standing.definition: the truth's rear-axle position and heading change between any two instants while the applied command stays exactly zero from each near capture's window start - L_hi (at most 0.5 s; a capture with a non-zero command there gives no span); D5 v11 V13 adds d0 + rho * phi0 to a frame placed by the anchor pose, and its replay rechecks each span against the truth
